Name: Zedekiah, Son of Hananiah
Summary: Zedekiah, son of Hananiah, was a prince of Jehoiakim's court who sat in the scribe's chamber when Michaiah reported Jeremiah's roll. He is a different man from Zedekiah the king and from Zedekiah son of Maaseiah.
KeyStory: Zedekiah son of Hananiah sat among the princes in Elishama's chamber when Michaiah declared all the words of the roll.
LifeLesson: Hearing God's word in the chamber is only the beginning — what the hearers do next is the story.
